title: Authority matrix — inspecting one cited source
titleEs: Matriz de autoridades — Inspección y cambio de un dato
description: A cork-board authority matrix assembles as supplied; a lens lifts a real enlarged copy of what identifies one citation — the proposition card, the head of the cited source and the cell with its pin, thread and pinpoint flag — with the columns in between collapsed. One datum is replaced by the preset’s alternative — which source the row cites (the pin travels along its thread to another column, or back to the card) or the pinpoint on its flag — while the old place keeps a dashed ghost and a struck value. The lens folds back; the context shows the new datum (a pending row gets a “source pending” note from the pad) with a “datum changed” tag. Seeking back restores the old datum.

durationMs.description: Total length of the finite timeline in milliseconds. Phases scale proportionally; the final state is held.

seed.description: Seed for small deterministic variations (appearance defaults, hand-drawn jitter). Same seed + time + params = same frame.

locale.description: Language of built-in labels (en or es). User-supplied text is never translated.

theme.description: Render treatment. Only tested themes are listed.

palette.description: Colour palette applied to props, actors and accents.

background.description: transparent, paper, white, light-grey, charcoal or a #rrggbb colour.

safeArea.description: Caption-safe margins as fractions of the frame.

reducedMotion.description: Removes decorative motion (overshoot, idle sway, camera drift) while keeping instructional motion.

textVisibility.description: all labels, key labels only, or none (the action must remain readable without labels).

jurisdiction.description: Descriptive jurisdiction tag. "unspecified" means no legal system is asserted.

contentNotice.description: Shows a small "illustrative example" tag inside the safe area.

query.description: Search printed on the results printout pinned in the corner of the matrix (fictional)

propositions.description: Propositions (matrix rows), top to bottom; each is printed on its own index card (fictional, descriptive) (array replaces the previous value)

id.description: Short identifier printed on the sheet band and on its volume

sources.description: Supplied sources (matrix columns), left to right; each is a sheet pinned across the top and a volume on the shelf (fictional) (array replaces the previous value)

dates.description: Date printed on each source sheet, same order as the sources (relative or fictional) (array replaces the previous value)

pinpoint.description: Pinpoint printed on the pin flag, e.g. "p. 2" or "¶ 4"

citations.description: Links supplied by the author: which source is cited for which proposition, with a pinpoint (fictional). Out-of-range or repeated pairs are ignored. A proposition without a citation is shown with a pending-source mark; nothing is inferred about whether a source supports it (array replaces the previous value)

focusTarget.description: Datum that is enlarged and substituted: "source" = which source the focus row cites (afterValue starting with a supplied source id moves the pin to that column, e.g. "S3 · p. 2"; any other afterValue means the source becomes pending); "pinpoint" = the text on the pin flag (beforeValue → afterValue)

beforeValue.description: Value named as "before" (for pinpoint it is also the flag text before the substitution)

afterValue.description: Alternative value: for "source", a supplied source id (optionally followed by a pinpoint, e.g. "S3 · p. 2") or a pending label; for "pinpoint", the new flag text

focusRow.description: Row (0 = first proposition) whose first supplied citation is inspected

propositions.text: Party A sent written notice on Day 3.
The goods reached the dock on Day 7.
Party B asked for a replacement unit.
